title: terebinthus simaruba
intro: Terebinthus simaruba, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a tropical tree native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Palo Santo include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever, cough, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include its ability to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and improve mood, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
